title: A clearer quick-start menu
summary: The bottom quick-start menu has larger circles and icons, with a background blur that fades to clear around the middle of the screen.
changes: Quick-start circles are now 52 px across, up from 44 px, with larger icons to make each option easier to see and tap.
Quick-start background blur is strongest at the bottom and fades to clear around mid-screen, keeping the top of your dashboard readable.

image.alt: Quick-start menu with larger circles and a background blur that fades to a clear dashboard around mid-screen.
